title: Texture Images
description: Analyzes texture image files (PNG, JPG, TGA) for dimensions, memory usage, and tiering compatibility. Ensures textures fit within platform memory budgets for different device tiers.

101.title: Texture Images
101.description: Count and analysis of all texture image files in the pack.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of texture images

200.title: Texture Images Tier0
200.description: Textures assigned to tier 0 (lowest quality) for subpack-based tiering. Used on very low-end devices.
200.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count or size of tier 0 textures

201.title: Texture Images Tier1
201.description: Textures assigned to tier 1 for subpack-based tiering. Used on low-end devices.
201.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count or size of tier 1 textures

202.title: Texture Images Tier2
202.description: Textures assigned to tier 2 for subpack-based tiering. Used on mid-range devices.
202.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count or size of tier 2 textures

203.title: Texture Images Tier3
203.description: Textures assigned to tier 3 for subpack-based tiering. Used on higher-end devices.
203.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count or size of tier 3 textures

204.title: Texture Images Tier4
204.description: Textures assigned to tier 4 for subpack-based tiering. Used on high-end devices.
204.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count or size of tier 4 textures

205.title: Texture Images Tier5
205.description: Textures assigned to tier 5 (highest quality) for subpack-based tiering. Used on premium devices.
205.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count or size of tier 5 textures

401.title: PNG/JPG Error
401.description: Error when a PNG or JPG image file could not be processed. The file may be corrupted or use an unsupported format variation.
401.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the problematic image file

402.title: Texture Over Budget
402.description: Error when a single texture exceeds the memory budget for its platform tier. Consider reducing texture dimensions or using compression.
402.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the memory size exceeding budget

403.title: Total Over Budget
403.description: Error when the combined memory of all textures exceeds platform limits. Reduce texture sizes or consolidate textures.
403.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the total memory exceeding budget

404.title: TGA Error
404.description: Error when a TGA image file could not be processed. The file may be corrupted or use an unsupported TGA format.
404.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the problematic TGA file

405.title: Atlas Over Budget
405.description: Error when a texture that will be atlased exceeds individual size limits. Atlas textures have stricter size requirements.
405.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the atlas texture size exceeding budget

406.title: Atlas Budget Warning
406.description: Warning when total atlas texture memory is approaching platform limits. Consider optimizing texture sizes.
406.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the atlas memory approaching limit

407.title: Atlas Budget Error
407.description: Error when total atlas texture memory exceeds platform limits. Reduce atlas texture sizes to ensure loading on target devices.
407.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the atlas memory exceeding limit

408.title: Empty Image
408.description: Warning when image processing completed but returned no usable data. The image may be empty or have zero dimensions.
408.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the empty image

409.title: Invalid Tiering
409.description: Error when subpack tiering configuration is invalid. Verify tier memory_tier values in manifest subpacks section.
409.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains details about the tiering configuration error

410.title: Vibrant Visuals Error
410.description: Error when tiering configuration is incompatible with Vibrant Visuals mode. Check subpack configuration.
410.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains details about the vibrant visuals configuration error

460.title: Missing Texture
460.description: Warning when a texture pack (70%+ vanilla override) is missing coverage for a vanilla texture. For complete texture packs, cover all vanilla textures.
460.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the vanilla texture path not overridden

461.title: Incomplete Override
461.description: Error when a pack appears to be a texture pack but overrides less than 95% of vanilla textures. Add missing texture overrides.

462.title: Mashup Incomplete
462.description: Error when a mashup pack's global resource pack overrides less than 60% of vanilla textures. Mashups should provide comprehensive visual theming.
462.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the override percentage for mashup
